title: 第13章 上官无情的图穷匕见第14章 上官无情 乖乖配合我就放过你
content_zh:
这可如何是好？
林陌一时犯了难。
他倒是可以继续举报周泽，问题是这一次又要如何将举报信交到柳紫嫣那里呢？
“老夫不过是想安安静静的修炼罢了，有这么难吗？”
林陌心中暗暗吐槽。
现在他是一个头两个大。
似乎看出了林陌的困扰，上官无情随即提议道：“我倒是可以给你一个一劳永逸的办法，想听听吗？”
“无情队长请讲。”
林陌竖起耳朵。
“我的住处正好缺一位杂役，你不如去我那里，我可以保你安享晚年。”
上官无情一脸严肃，看上去不像是在开玩笑。
闻言，林陌顿时警觉了起来。
在他听来，上官无情这种话简直就像是一个小女孩在路上遇到一个陌生怪叔叔，跟她说叔叔家里有好吃的糖果一样。
“这就是纯阳圣体？真是不讲道理！”
林陌暗暗心惊。
他现在还只是一副糟老头子的模样，纯阳圣体的魅魔体质，就已经可以将上官无情给迷得神魂颠倒了。
要是再年轻个十几二十岁，林陌都不敢想象会是一番什么样的景象。
林陌上下打量了上官无情一眼。
该说不说，上官无情身材确实不错。
该大的地方大，该翘的地方翘，那宛如水蛇般的小蛮腰，一看就是特意训练过的结果。

长相也是那种英姿飒爽的耐看类型。
虽然比之不上柳紫嫣，但放在整个初圣宗而言，上官无情的颜值也绝对是属于第一梯队的。
但问题是，这里可是初圣宗啊！
吃人不吐骨头的初圣宗！
鬼知道上官无情肚子里究竟有多少坏水？
执法堂的分队队长又如何？林陌根本信不过她。
他还是想回到紫天宫，回到自己的小木屋里，安安静静地修炼。
“咳咳...无情队长，老夫不过一介时日无多的杂役，何德何能承受您如此恩情？”
林陌作出一副诚惶诚恐的模样，婉拒道：“您的好意，老夫心领了，您就不用管我了，任由我自生自灭吧。”
上官无情沉默了好一会儿，方才一摊手，坦然道：“随意，我不过是看你可怜，想帮你一把而已。”
“既然你不需要，我自然乐意放下助人情节，尊重他人命运。”
林陌双手合十，感激道：“感谢无情队长理解，既然不需要配合调查和问询，老夫可以回去了吗？”
“随时可以。”
上官无情没有过多为难林陌，只是在做了一个简单的登记之后，便放他离开了。
从执法堂朱雀分队办事处出来。
林陌迈着岣嵝的身躯，迈入夜色之中。
“总感觉哪里不太对...”
虽然顺利从朱雀分队办事处出来了，但林陌总有一股惴惴不安的预感。
那上官无情，真有那么容易放过自己吗？
“还是赶紧回去为妙。”

没有时间多想，林陌加快了脚步。
并不是回杂役部，而是回到紫天宫门口的小木屋。
只有在柳紫嫣的眼皮子底下，他才有一丝的安全感。
其他人尚且不清楚，至少林陌现在可以确定，柳紫嫣暂时不会杀他。
content_en:
What should I do?
Lin Mo was in trouble for a moment.
He could continue to report Zhou Ze, but the question was how to deliver the report letter to Liu Ziyan this time?
"I just want to practice quietly. Is it so difficult?"
Lin Mo complained secretly in his heart.
Now he is one head and two big.
As if he could see Lin Mo's troubles, Shangguan Wuqing immediately suggested: "I can give you a once and for all solution. Do you want to hear it?"
"Captain Ruthless, please speak."
Lin Mo pricked up his ears.
"My residence happens to be short of a handyman. Why don't you go to my place and I can ensure that you enjoy your old age in peace."
Shangguan Qingqing had a serious face and didn't look like he was joking.
Hearing this, Lin Mo suddenly became alert.
To him, Shangguan Wuqing's words were like a little girl meeting a strange uncle on the road and telling her that his uncle's house had delicious candies.
"Is this the Pure Yang Holy Body? It's really unreasonable!"
Lin Mo was secretly shocked.
He just looks like a bad old man now, but the succubus physique of Pure Yang Holy Body can already make Shangguan Qingqing fascinated.
If he were ten or twenty years younger, Lin Mo couldn't imagine what it would be like.
Lin Mo looked Shangguan Qingqing up and down.
Needless to say, Shangguan Wuqing is indeed in good shape.
It's big where it should be, and it's curved where it should be. That small waist like a water snake is the result of special training at first glance.
His appearance is also the kind of handsome and handsome type.
Although not as good as Liu Ziyan, in terms of the entire Chu Sheng Sect, Shangguan Wuqing's appearance definitely belongs to the first echelon.
But the problem is, this is the First Saint Sect!
The First Saint Sect who eats people without spitting out their bones!
Who knows how much bad water Shangguan Qingqing has in his belly?
What about the team leader of the Law Enforcement Hall? Lin Mo couldn't trust her at all.
He still wanted to return to Zitian Palace, his cabin, and practice quietly.
"Ahem...Captain Ruthless, I'm just a handyman who doesn't have much time left. How can He De accept such kindness from you?"
Lin Mo pretended to be sincere and frightened, and declined politely: "I understand your kindness, so you don't need to worry about me, just let me fend for myself."
Shangguan Wuqing was silent for a while, then he spread his hands and said calmly: "It's okay, I just feel sorry for you and want to help you."
"Since you don't need it, I am naturally willing to put aside the plot of helping others and respect the fate of others."
Lin Mo clasped his hands together and said gratefully: "Thank you Captain Qingqing for your understanding. Since there is no need to cooperate with the investigation and questioning, can I go back?"
"Any time."
Shangguan Wuqing didn't embarrass Lin Mo too much. He just let him go after a simple registration.
Come out of the Suzaku branch office of the Law Enforcement Hall.
Lin Mo walked into the night with his tall body.
"I always feel like something is not right..."
Although he came out of the Suzaku branch office smoothly, Lin Mo always had an uneasy feeling.
Then Shangguan Wu was ruthless, was it really that easy to let him go?
"It's better to go back quickly."
Without time to think, Lin Mo quickened his pace.
Not back to the handyman department, but back to the cabin at the entrance of Zitian Palace.
Only under Liu Ziyan's nose did he feel a sense of security.
Others still don't know, but at least Lin Mo can now be sure that Liu Ziyan will not kill him for the time being.
